description: Na₅Ag₂Fe₃(As₂O₇)₄ crystallizes in the monoclinic C2/c space group. There are three inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.36-2.88 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.33-2.55 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.35-2.75 Å. There are two inequivalent Fe sites. In the first Fe site, Fe is bonded to six O atoms to form FeO₆ octahedra that share corners with six AsO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Fe-O bond distances ranging from 2.00-2.12 Å. In the second Fe site, Fe is bonded to six O atoms to form FeO₆ octahedra that share corners with six AsO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Fe-O bond distances ranging from 2.00-2.08 Å. Ag is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of Ag-O bond distances ranging from 2.40-2.68 Å. There are four inequivalent As sites. In the first As site, As is bonded to four O atoms to form AsO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with three equivalent FeO₆ octahedra and  a cornercorner with one AsO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 47-51°. There are a spread of As-O bond distances ranging from 1.70-1.78 Å. In the second As site, As is bonded to four O atoms to form AsO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent FeO₆ octahedra and  a cornercorner with one AsO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 44-50°. There are a spread of As-O bond distances ranging from 1.69-1.80 Å. In the third As site, As is bonded to four O atoms to form AsO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent FeO₆ octahedra and  a cornercorner with one AsO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 44-53°. There are a spread of As-O bond distances ranging from 1.70-1.81 Å. In the fourth As site, As is bonded to four O atoms to form AsO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two FeO₆ octahedra and  a cornercorner with one AsO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 50-52°. There are a spread of As-O bond distances ranging from 1.67-1.82 Å. There are fourteen inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to two Na and one As atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na and two As atoms. In the third O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal non-coplanar geometry to one Na, one Fe, and one As atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a bent 120 degrees geometry to one Fe and one As atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a bent 120 degrees geometry to two As atoms. In the sixth O site, O is bonded to two Na, one Ag, and one As atom to form distorted corner-sharing ONa₂AgAs tetrahedra. In the seventh O site, O is bonded to two Na, one Ag, and one As atom to form distorted corner-sharing ONa₂AgAs tetrahedra. In the eighth O site, O is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to one Na, one Fe, and one As atom. In the ninth O site, O is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to one Fe, one Ag, and one As atom. In the tenth O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to one Na, one Fe, and one As atom. In the eleventh O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Fe, and one As atom. In the twelfth O site, O is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to one Fe, one Ag, and one As atom. In the thirteenth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na, one Fe, and one As atom. In the fourteenth O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 120 degrees geometry to one Fe and one As atom.
